intent: Initial balanced geometry with moderate size and mass, 5 mid-sized sensors arranged symmetrically near the front to maximize line detection and stability. Expect to gather baseline performance data to guide next iteration's geometry tuning.
rationale: Since this is the first iteration, we have no integration feedback or race telemetry yet. To start, I propose a balanced geometry with moderate body size and mass, a mid-sized sensor size, and a reasonable number of sensors arranged symmetrically near the front centerline to maximize line detection. This setup aims to provide good stability and sensor coverage for line following, which should help the controller build a reliable model. We request measurements on completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to diagnose performance and sensor effectiveness in the next iteration. Based on the next telemetry, we will adjust sensor count, placement, or body dimensions to improve line detection and stability.
